# system.registerMultimoduleProtocol

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.3.0</span></div>

Register a Multimodule Protocol.

```lua
system.registerMultimoduleProtocol(label, id, params)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string | yes | protocol name |
| `id` | int | yes | protocol ID |
| `params` | table | yes | see the fields below |

Fields of `params`:

- `variants` (table, optional): protocol variants
- `minChannels` (unsigned, optional): minimum channels count
- `maxChannels` (unsigned, optional): maximum channels count
- `features` (unsigned, optional): protocol features
- `options` (table of options, optional): protocol options with elements:
    - `name` (string): option name
    - `min` (int): option min
    - `max` (int): option max
    - `display` (function, optional): display function for the option value


## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
local function init()
  system.registerMultimoduleProtocol("Hubsan", 2, {variants={"H107", "H301", "H501"}, minChannels=8, maxChannels=16})
end
```
